name: manual_c4684c
claim: Never report test isolation that was not verified path by path: every test directory, child processes, and each environment variable the code actually reads. Check the engine's loaded-model list and request log after each run.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-28 local 12:18:50: a run reported as engine-blocked loaded bge-m3 again three seconds after it started. Its first file sat outside the guarded test directory and starts a child process. The cause was found in the engine log, not by the run.
